description: Patch schema for local BiRefNet-HR background removal through ComfyUI-RMBG.

unmapped_ui_parameters.frames: The existing BiRefNet UI section is preserved, but the local workflow is a single-image alpha-matte operation.
unmapped_ui_parameters.steps: BiRefNetRMBG is segmentation inference, not sampler-based generation.
unmapped_ui_parameters.guidance: BiRefNetRMBG does not expose CFG guidance.

output.contract: Return a readable PNG with an alpha channel and the same dimensions as the input image.
